verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a robots.txt-compliance setting or automatic per-site rate limiting in Crawl4AI. Proxy retry, stealth and undetected-browser features are adjacent capabilities, not politeness controls. A community commenter lists robots and rate limiting as production concerns users must handle themselves, which also does not show the product provides them.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can configure the crawler to respect robots.txt rules and target-site rate limits automatically
